description: Detect styleguide drift by comparing declared config conventions against observed signals in scene prose.

chapter.description: Optional read-scope compatibility alias resolved through canonical chapter identity. Not a structural mutation target.

include_clean_scenes.description: If true, include scenes with no detected drift in scene_results.

max_scenes.description: Maximum number of scenes to analyze (default: 50).

min_agreement.description: Minimum agreement ratio for suggested updates (default: 0.6).

name: check_prose_styleguide_drift
